models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
Registered user accounts with email/password authentication credentials and profile information.

The primary actor entity for the TodoApp system. Each user has a private workspace with complete data isolation. No user can access, view, or detect the existence of another user's data under any circumstances. This table contains the core identity information: encrypted email, bcrypt-hashed password, and display name.

All authentication flows (registration, login, password reset) depend on this table. All API endpoints scope queries to this user's UUID. Account deletion triggers full data cascade soft-delete of all associated todos and related records.

This table serves as the anchor for the entire application's privacy architecture - every query must include user_id = authenticated_user_id to enforce strict data isolation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Encrypted email address used for user identification and communication. Must be unique across the system for authentication purposes.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: bcrypt-hashed value of the user's password. Never stores plaintext passwords. Used for authentication verification during login.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name. Defaults to email prefix (text before @) if not set manually. Used in UI for identification. Max 50 characters, no HTML/JS injection allowed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this user account was created. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to this user's profile. Updated on email, password, or display name changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the user account is marked as deleted. All associated data is soft-deleted but retained for audit. NULL indicates active account.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description: Login session records for authenticated users. Each entry represents a distinct connection session with tracking of IP, referrer, and session duration. Append-only audit trail of user authentication events.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated user account. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL to which the user's browser was redirected upon login.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The previous web page the user visited before initiating the login session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Scheduled expiration time for this session. Sessions must expire by default for security reasons.

models.name: todo_app_user_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens with expiration for user registration confirmation.

Stores unique, time-limited verification tokens that users receive after registration to confirm their email addresses. Each token is generated once per registration attempt and must be used within its expiration window to activate the account.

The token itself is a cryptographically secure random string that provides no information about the user's identity. Tokens are single-use and expire after 24 hours by default. Each verification record is tightly coupled to a specific user account through the foreign key relationship with todo_app_users.

This table exists solely to facilitate the account verification process and is managed automatically by the system - users never directly interact with this table except by clicking the verification link in their email. Once the token is used or expired, the record remains in the database for audit purposes.

The table does not store user email addresses (already in todo_app_users) or any other personally identifiable information beyond the token and timestamp references.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user account that this verification token belongs to. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique cryptographic token used for email verification. Must be unguessable and secure. Used to authenticate the verification request when the user clicks the link in their email.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token was generated and sent to the user. Records when the registration process initiated the verification flow.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token expires. After this time, the token becomes invalid and cannot be used for verification. Tokens typically expire after 24 hours for security.

models.name: todo_app_user_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens with expiration for secure user password recovery workflow.

This table stores temporary, single-use tokens that allow users to reset their passwords when they forget their credentials. Each token is associated with a specific user and has an expiration time to prevent abuse. Once a token is used to reset a password, it becomes invalid and should be marked as deleted.

The reset token is a cryptographically random value that is sent to the user's registered email address. It must be expired within a short time window (typically 1-2 hours) for security reasons. The table tracks when the token was created and when it expires, allowing the system to automatically invalidate expired tokens.

This table is not directly managed by users—it is created automatically during password reset requests and deleted after use or expiration. It serves as a critical security mechanism that enables password recovery while maintaining account integrity.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced user account that requested the password reset. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique, cryptographically-random reset token string. This token is sent to the user's email and must be kept secret.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp when this reset token becomes invalid. Must be set to a time shortly after creation (e.g., 1-2 hours).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset token was generated and sent to the user.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record (e.g., when marked as used or deleted).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, indicates the token has been used, expired, or revoked. Tokens with non-null deleted_at are considered invalid.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
A user's individual task with title, description, and optional date fields.

Each todo represents a discrete task that a user needs to complete. Users can independently create, view, edit, complete, delete, and manage their todos through the application interface.

Todos are owned exclusively by the authenticated user and cannot be accessed, viewed, or even detected by other users due to strict data isolation policies.

The title field is required and limited to 200 characters to ensure conciseness. The description is optional and can contain up to 2,000 characters for detailed task information.

Start and due dates are optional and can be used for planning purposes. Completion status is a toggleable boolean indicating whether the task has been completed.

All todos have soft delete capability with deleted_at field to maintain audit trails while allowing content removal from active views.

Every todo has mandatory temporal fields (created_at, updated_at) for tracking creation and modification history, and is always linked to exactly one authenticated user.

This entity follows strict 3NF normalization with no denormalized or computed fields.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The user who owns this todo. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The title of the todo task. Must be 1-200 characters long. Required field that cannot be empty.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo task. Maximum length is 2,000 characters. Can be empty.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ). If not provided, stores as null.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ). If not provided, stores as null.

plainFields.name: completion_status
plainFields.description: Current completion status of the todo. true = completed, false = incomplete. Default is false when created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when this todo was created. Always set automatically and never null.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when this todo was last updated. Always updated automatically on any modification and never null.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: The timestamp when this todo was soft-deleted. If null, the todo is still active. If set, the todo is in trash and not visible in normal lists.
